name: Windskiff

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond item page in signed-in Chrome on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/10771757-windskiff. Prices use the existing rarity convention; unspecified weight is 0. Reference-only properties require manual adjudication.

summary: Reference-only: three charges, fully restored each dawn.
text: Reference-only: three charges, fully restored each dawn. While holding the jewelry, a Magic action spends 1 charge to unfold a personal sailing vehicle for 1 hour, or until you freely speak its command word. Medium object: AC 12, HP 30, Speed 40 feet; door-sized with a 10-foot sail. It hovers just above the surface and glides 5 feet horizontally for every foot descended. The vehicle and its riders take no falling damage.
